title: totalvi_scarches_leiden
description: Run totalVI integration by mapping the query dataset to a reference, followed by neighbour calculations, leiden clustering and run umap on the result.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['dataset.h5mu']`

layer.description: use specified layer for expression values instead of the .X object from the modality.

reference.description: Input h5mu file with reference data to train the TOTALVI model.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['output.h5mu']`

reference_model_path.description: Directory with the reference model. If not exists, trained model will be saved there

query_model_path.description: Directory, where the query model will be saved

obs_batch.description: .Obs column name discriminating between your batches.

obs_size_factor.description:
Key in adata.obs for size factor information. Instead of using library size as a size factor,
the provided size factor column will be used as offset in the mean of the likelihood.
Assumed to be on linear scale.

obs_categorical_covariate.description:
Keys in adata.obs that correspond to categorical data. These covariates can be added in
addition to the batch covariate and are also treated as nuisance factors
(i.e., the model tries to minimize their effects on the latent space).
Thus, these should not be used for biologically-relevant factors that you do _not_ want to correct for.

obs_continuous_covariate.description:
Keys in adata.obs that correspond to continuous data. These covariates can be added in
addition to the batch covariate and are also treated as nuisance factors
(i.e., the model tries to minimize their effects on the latent space). Thus, these should not be
used for biologically-relevant factors that you do _not_ want to correct for.

max_epochs.description: Number of passes through the dataset

max_query_epochs.description: Number of passes through the dataset, when fine-tuning model for query

weight_decay.description: Weight decay, when fine-tuning model for query

force_retrain.description: If true, retrain the model and save it to reference_model_path

var_input.description: Boolean .var column to subset data with (e.g. containing highly variable genes). By default, do not subset genes.

rna_obsm_output.description: In which .obsm slot to store the normalized RNA from TOTALVI.

prot_reference_modality.description: Name of the modality containing proteins in the reference

prot_obsm_output.description: In which .obsm slot to store the normalized protein data from TOTALVI.

rna_uns_neighbors.description: In which .uns slot to store various neighbor output objects.

rna_obsp_neighbor_distances.description: In which .obsp slot to store the distance matrix between the resulting neighbors.

rna_obsp_neighbor_connectivities.description: In which .obsp slot to store the connectivities matrix between the resulting neighbors.

prot_uns_neighbors.description: In which .uns slot to store various neighbor output objects.

prot_obsp_neighbor_distances.description: In which .obsp slot to store the distance matrix between the resulting neighbors.

prot_obsp_neighbor_connectivities.description: In which .obsp slot to store the connectivities matrix between the resulting neighbors.

rna_obs_cluster.description:
Prefix for the .obs keys under which to add the cluster labels. Newly created columns in .obs will 
be created from the specified value for '--obs_cluster' suffixed with an underscore and one of the resolutions
resolutions specified in '--leiden_resolution'.

rna_leiden_resolution.description: Control the coarseness of the clustering. Higher values lead to more clusters.

prot_obs_cluster.description:
Prefix for the .obs keys under which to add the cluster labels. Newly created columns in .obs will 
be created from the specified value for '--obs_cluster' suffixed with an underscore and one of the resolutions
resolutions specified in '--leiden_resolution'.

prot_leiden_resolution.description: Control the coarseness of the clustering. Higher values lead to more clusters.

obsm_umap.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting UMAP embedding.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
